name: npm Private Feeds
description: Configures private npm registry feeds. Writes scope→registry URL mappings to the global .npmrc at build time. At post-create time, stores auth token entries in the user-only ~/.npmrc using the PAT from the specified env var.

feeds.description: Semicolon-separated list of feed entries in the format '@scope|registryUrl' or '@scope|registryUrl|TOKEN_VAR'. TOKEN_VAR overrides the fallback token-env-var for that specific feed. E.g. '@myorg|https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/org/_packaging/feed/npm/registry/|AZURE_PAT;@other|https://npm.example.com/|OTHER_PAT'

token-env-var.description: Fallback env var name for feeds that do not specify their own TOKEN_VAR in the feeds string.
